_note: No simple public REST API exists for BSL lookups (unlike PubChem for GHS data), so this is a small hand-authored reference table -- see README 'Data'. Extend it deliberately; an organism missing from here must resolve as found:false, not as BSL-1-by-default.

entries.notes: Standard microbiological practices; non-pathogenic laboratory strain.
Standard precautions for organisms associated with human disease of moderate potential hazard.
Requires controlled access, directional airflow, and respiratory protection for aerosol-generating procedures.
Federal Select Agent; requires BSL-3 practices plus additional biosecurity controls.
entries.source: BMBL 6th Edition, Section VIII-C; Federal Select Agent Program

entries.notes: Follow institutional biosafety committee guidance; higher containment recommended for viral culture or aerosol-generating work.
BSL-2 standard practices, with BSL-3 practices for activities with increased aerosol or droplet potential.
Risk group depends entirely on the transgene being delivered; this is not a fixed BSL and must be reviewed per-construct.
entries.source: NIH Guidelines for Research Involving Recombinant or Synthetic Nucleic Acid Molecules
